description: The line plot illustrates the average performance (%) of three metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—across a range of model sizes, with the x-axis representing model size in millions (m) and billions (B), and the y-axis showing average performance as a percentage. The x-axis spans from 70 million to 7 billion, with labeled points at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B, and the y-axis ranges from 0 to 80 percent. The red line with triangle markers, labeled "Precision," starts at approximately 78% for the 70m model and shows a slight decreasing trend, ending at around 76% for the 7.0B model. The blue line with triangle markers, labeled "Recall," begins at about 8% for the 70m model and steadily increases, reaching approximately 45% for the 7.0B model. The purple line with triangle markers, labeled "F1-score," starts at around 15% for the 70m model and increases to about 55% for the 7.0B model. All three lines exhibit a generally increasing trend in performance as model size increases, with Precision remaining the highest-performing metric throughout.
